asset_owner.description: the utility owner or network operator

depth_m.description: the depth of the utility below surface

detection_method.description: how the position was obtained, e.g. records, electromagnetic locator, ground-penetrating radar or trial pit

horizontal_accuracy_m.description: the horizontal accuracy of the position

horizontal_datum.description: the datum and projection of the geometry, e.g. MGA2020 zone 56

project.description: the project the utility was located on

quality_level.description: the quality level of the location information, QL-D to QL-A

quality_level_scheme.description: the scheme and edition the level is from, e.g. AS 5488.1:2022

report_reference.description: the survey report the location comes from

source_system.description: which bound system emitted the row

utility_type.description: the service, e.g. water, gas, electrical or telecommunications

vertical_accuracy_m.description: the vertical accuracy of the position

vertical_datum.description: the datum any depth or level is referenced to, e.g. AHD
